Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: On arrival at the parking lot in Houston, Texas, I found two vehicles with contact damage at the frnot
of Driver 1's sedan and the rear quarter panel of Driver 2's SUV. Driver 1 stated that while backing out of a space, the
sedan struck the SUV as it passed behind. Driver 2 confirmed this account and said the impact was low speed but
firm. Two bystanders independently described the same sequence, and photographs taken at the scene show
damage consistent with that impact. The damage pattern on both vehicles lines up with the contact described.
Passenger, seated in the front right seat of Driver 1's vehicle, was present during the collision and was identified by
both drivers and a witness. Passenger reported neck and back pain and stiffness, which is a typical complaint after a
collision of this kind. No prior damage to either vehicle was noted by the drivers or observed at the scene. Driver 1
provided proof of insurance, and the vehicle is listed under Driver 1's policy. No citations were issued at the scene.
</page>
